pilots.notes: Alpha 24 first one-of-ten original hand-composed painterly study. Raster-painted editable PSD/KRA masters and physical device signoff still not delivered. Compare original vs pilot only in Draft review-v4.html #warm / #warm-pilot.

Alpha 25 unique blue-hour distant mountain study; own long jagged ridge, pale moonlit scree and sparse pigment. Paired A/B and seam proof in Draft review only. This is NOT final high-resolution raster master art.
Alpha 26 independently composed warm mid-distance foothills, amber stone facets and sage-shadow planes; preview supports mid-only or stack alongside warm far pilot. Never used by actual game.
Alpha 26 independently composed cool slate midrange ridge with moonlit limestone facets and subdued blue-basin values. QA-only mid/stack preview; not approved for runtime.
Alpha 27 warm valley air perspective, translucent cream/sage bands and separated pigment pools; QA-only original transparent study, not production.
Alpha 27 slate blue-hour mist study, independently placed cool lunar haze pools and silver-blue envelope; QA-only non-runtime layer.
Alpha 28 independent nonrepeating dawn gradient and warm sunrise anchored at 1170px game x; subdued sun disc, broad cloud and pigment bank QA only.
Alpha 28 distinct nonrepeating blue-hour luminance palette, lunar halo anchored at 1230px game x, sparse stars and independent dusk cloud masses, QA only.

Alpha29 hand-authored dawn valley close broadleaf canopy; 11 independently drawn trees, restrained sandy foreground gouache, seamless ridge, no live runtime change. Alpha30: organic asymmetrical woodland canopy, 3+ crown families and layered branches, unchanged ridge.

Alpha29 independently hand-authored blue-hour alpine conifers, 11 slender spruce silhouettes, dark granite foothill washes and tile-aligned ridge, reviewer-only. Alpha30: uneven spruce/fir/larch crown silhouettes, asymmetric branching and fewer repeated triangular motifs, unchanged ridge.
